NONE: › informal for
mum noun
› UK old-fashioned or US informal a mother
媽媽
› US slang a woman, especially an attractive one
（尤指有吸引力的）女子

example: [ as form of address ] Can I have some more, Mama?
我可以再要一點嗎，媽媽？
There's a good-looking mama sitting at the bar.
吧台前坐著一位漂亮女子。

NONE: › a boy or man who appears to do whatever his mother tells him to
凡事都聽媽媽的話的男孩（或男人）
› a very poisonous snake that lives mainly in caves or trees in parts of Africa
樹眼鏡蛇，曼巴（一種巨毒蛇，主要生活在非洲部分地區的洞穴中或樹上）
C1 any animal of which the female feeds her young on milk from her own body. Most mammals give birth to live young, not eggs.
哺乳動物

example: Humans, dogs, elephants, and dolphins are all mammals, but birds, fish, and crocodiles are not.
人、狗、大象和海豚都是哺乳動物，而鳥、魚和鱷魚則不是。

這是一項艱巨的任務——你肯定有能力完成嗎？
